geom_rule: W = D + 1mm < 2*D  =>  channel fits only one pill across

eq.disc_drive: theta_i(t) = theta0_i + omega*t  (all pills, same omega)
eq.wall_contact: r := r_wall(theta) + clearance  (inelastic, wall-only, no pill-pill force in this model)
eq.no_overtake: theta_i(t) - theta_j(t) = theta0_i - theta0_j = const for all t
eq.single_file_geom: W = D + PILL_CLEAR_XY < 2*D for all D > PILL_CLEAR_XY

note: Cac vien duoc rai ban dau cach nhau >= D+1mm (khong chong luc tha); vi khong co luc vien-vien trong mo hinh tiep-xuc-thanh hien tai, khoang cach cap toi thieu duoc do lai suot quy dao de xac nhan khong vien nao cham/vuot vien khac truoc khi ra Exit_Track.
